identity_attestation: caller-declared; server weights/settings are not inspected

request.prompt:
Scrivi in Python una piccola cache LRU con capacita configurabile, metodi get e put, e operazioni in tempo O(1). Non usare librerie esterne. Includi un breve esempio con capacita 2 e tre chiavi. Poi spiega in italiano perche una cache LRU elimina la chiave meno recentemente utilizzata e come gestisci l'aggiornamento di una chiave gia presente. Ragiona sui casi limite e sul costo in memoria.
Risposta:

prompt_token_calibration: not performed; actual counts come from each response usage
warmup_policy: same prompt and decode parameters as measured requests
prefix_cache_state: caller-managed; this harness does not clear or disable server caches

metric_source.server_inference_tokens_per_second: metrics.tokens_per_second = output tokens / (scheduled to last output token); includes prefill, excludes queue wait
metric_source.decode_tokens_per_second: (completion_tokens - 1) * 1000 / metrics.generation_time_ms; first to last output token, excludes first-token/prefill interval
metric_source.http_output_tokens_per_second: usage.completion_tokens / client HTTP elapsed; includes request/response, queue, prefill and paired-frontend completion
metric_source.ttft: metrics.time_to_first_token_ms is server scheduled-to-first token; client TTFT is unavailable for non-streaming requests

publisher_comparability: not established: a provided prompt is not automatically the publisher's 2048-input/128-output workload, nor the earlier local 109/256 workload
